notes.title: Wood & Weather - Annoncement Trailer!
notes.content:
We've been working on a new game titled Wood & Weather and we have finally put out a trailer showing it off! 
[previewyoutube=ideURBUsqhs;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Wood & Weather[/b] is a single player god-game set in a wooden toy city. Make friends and control the weather as an ethereal blue hand in a surprising little open world. 🌤 🌦 ⛈ ❄️ ☂️ 🍃 

We originally showed this trailer off to a crowd of 400 people as a surprise during Parallels last year. It was really amazing to hear the whole room respond to the trailer in real time. ✨⚡️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33894261/c914569f54d77f8f58d4e4428222d946ac7bfd9a.jpg[/img]

👉 You can check out the Steam page here, which has more information about the game. Feel free to Follow or Wishlist, if you're into that kind of thing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677010/Wood__Weather/

- Paper House

notes.title: Happy End of Year!
notes.content:
Happy End of Year!!

This year has been pretty big and very busy for us at Paper House! We've been working on a new game and setting up a new small studio for us to work out of. 

It feels like we say this every post, but thank you to everyone who has supported us and continues to support our tiny wombat game. We love to still hear stories of people playing and sharing Paperbark and we hope you all had a wonderful 2021!  

Shout out to Cole for our wonderful end of year image, which features some stylised wattle, bottle brush and a friendly butterfly.

Can't wait to share what we have planned for next year! See you all in 2022! ːwombathappyːːwombatloveːːwombatcuteː

Thanks again,

- Paper House

notes.title: HAPPY 3rd BIRTHDAY PAPERBARK!
notes.content:
[b]HAPPY 3RD BIRTHDAY TO OUR CLUMSY WOMBAT![/b]

This time three years ago, the very tired Paper House team finally hit 'submit' for our game and released it into the wild. It was one of the hardest things we've ever done and are still very proud of our humble little game. 

Paperbark (which started as a small Uni project) has taken us overseas, given us everlasting experiences and allowed us to meet some life long friends. We owe a lot to our little wombat friend and all of you for your on going support.

Thank you again to everyone and HAPPY 3rd BIRTHDAY LITTLE WOMBAT!

- Paper House xo ːwombatloveː ːwombathappyː

notes.title: Happy Wattle Week!
notes.content:
It's a wonderful time of the year where we get to celebrate the changing of seasons and the arrival of our favourite yellow flower, wattle.

For some people who don't know, wattle ([url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acacia]Acacia[/url]) is a type of bush/scrub and is native to Africa and Australia. We have lots of different types here in Australia and one of them in particular (Acacia paradoxa) features quite a lot in Paperbark.

Each year on [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wattle_Day]September 1st[/url], we put some time aside to appreciate all of the beautiful yellow flowers coming into bloom around us.

We like this time oh year a lot and because of this [b]we have put Paperbark on sale[/b]. We hope you can appreciate the wonder that is wattle as well! ːwombathappyː

Happy Wattle [strike]Day[/strike] Week everyone!

- Paper House

notes.title: Humble Australian Fire Relief Bundle
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We're proud to announce that [i]Paperbark[/i] is included in a special [b][url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/australia-fire-relief]Australian Fire Relief Bundle[/url][/b], that has been curated by Humble.

The bundle has an amazing selection of games, mostly consisting of Australian developers (most of which are our peers and friends).

It only costs $25 and 100% of the proceeds will go towards supporting wildlife via the[b] RSPCA[/b], [b]WIRES[/b] and [b]World Wildlife Fund[/b]

The bundle includes:
[b]- Hollow Knight
- Void Bastards
- Armello
- Adventure Pals
- Crawl
- Paradigm
- Frog Detective (Episode 1)
- The Gardens Between
- Plus more![/b]

You can find the full list and bundle [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/australia-fire-relief]here[/url]

The fires have been absolutely devastating and something we are all experiencing first hand. Even our home town (and major city) of Melbourne is constantly engulfed with toxic smoke from the fires, preventing us from even going outside.

Every piece of support helps.

Thanks again

- Paper House ːwombathappyː

notes.title: Paperbark Trading Cards!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Paperbark officially has Steam Trading Card support!

We worked pretty hard creating some new hand-drawn content for the Trading Cards and we're really pleased with how they turned out! 

By collecting all of the cards, you can create a Paperbark badge, which also unlocks a variety of emoticons and wallpapers for your profile.

This also means your achievements contribute to your global total and can be featured on your Steam profile!

Thanks again to everyone for playing our little game. It means a lot. :wombatlove:

notes.title: Paperbark is currently 25% off for World Environment Day! 🍃🌿
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33894261/89e79e21d5d873071bcae21b255dd5e8b32793d8.png[/img]

Paperbark is a part of a limited sale running at the moment for World Environment Day! It's currently on sale for [b]25% off[/b].

World Environment Day is the United Nations day for encouraging worldwide awareness and action to protect our environment. Since it began in 1974, the event has grown to become a global platform for public outreach that is widely celebrated in over 100 countries.

The focus this year is to tackle air pollution and its devastating effects on the world.

There are so many things that can be done: from cycling or walking to work and back, to recycling non-organic trash, to pressuring local authorities to improve green spaces in our cities. Here are some of their suggestions:

- Turn off lights and electronics not in use.
- Check efficiency ratings for home heating systems and cookstoves to choose models that save money and protect health.
- Never burn trash, as this contributes directly to air pollution.

You can find out more information by heading to the [url=https://www.worldenvironmentday.global/]World Environment Day[/url] website.

- Paper House

notes.title: Paperbark has won Gold in the Indigo Design Awards!
notes.content:
Paperbark has won Gold in the [i]'Illustration for Games' [/i]category for the [b][i]Indigo Design Awards[/i][/b]! 🏅🌿🎨

We spent a huge amount of time trying to create a game that was not only honest to the landscape in which it was set, but presented in a unique and stylised way. It's always nice to be formally recognised for this hard work.

This wouldn't have been achieved without the huge amount of talent from our Art Director, Nina Bennett. 

You can see the great selection of 2019 winners here:
www.indigoawards.com/winners

notes.title: Paperbark - Hotfix 21/12
notes.content:
We've just sent out a small update for Mac and Windows to fix a couple of small known issues.

- Fixed a visual issue when dragging library stickers.
- Fixed a rare case where the cicada sticker would not unlock after finding the final cicada.
- Fixed an macOS issue where the game would sometimes hang on the Paper House splash screen.
- Increased the 'Wombat Rush' achievement time from 16min to 18min. To bring it's difficulty in line with other achievements.

Thanks again for playing!

- Paper House
